description: Defines a Polymer behavior for a checkable element with validation features, including properties like 'checked', 'toggles', and 'value', and methods for handling validity and state changes.

classes.name: Polymer.IronCheckedElementBehaviorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the behavior with properties 'checked', 'toggles', 'value', and methods for validation and state management.

methods.name: _getValidity
methods.description: Returns false if the element is required and not checked; true otherwise.

methods.name: _checkedChanged
methods.description: Updates 'active' state and 'value' when 'checked' changes; fires 'iron-change' event.
